Pillar of Prosperity: Health and Healthcare

Each county scored 0 to 10, with equal weight on the age-adjusted premature death rate (under 75) and on access to care (primary care physicians, pooled with neighboring counties, and the uninsured rate under 65). Pick a year, then hover or tap a county for its score and trend.

Score vs. national median · each shade = 1 point
BelowAt or above

Zoom with the buttons, a trackpad pinch, Ctrl/⌘ + scroll, or double-click. Drag to pan. Arrow keys ← → change the year.

Colors compare every year with one fixed line, the national median county score (): red is below it, blue is at or above it, and each shade is one point further away. Because the line doesn't move, a map getting bluer or redder over time reflects real change. Scores use fixed 2010–12 goalposts, so they can be compared across years. Rank is within the selected year (1 = healthiest). Alaska and Hawaii are moved and resized. Gray = not scored.

Sources: CDC WONDER (deaths), HRSA Area Health Resources File (physicians), Census SAHIE (insurance) and Population Estimates.
